requirements: Replay bundle events must be a non-empty array.
Bundle format, event schema, and projection version headers must be non-empty strings and are never coerced from other types.
A replay history must begin with exactly one RelationshipCreated event authored by tria:system.
Malformed bundles and invalid relationship roots fail closed before import writes any events.
A valid hash chain alone is insufficient when the history is not a valid TRIA relationship history.
